purpose: Manual 640x360 landmark evidence for auditing table-camera framing. This file diagnoses a mismatch; it does not authorize changing camera calibration or table geometry.

real_fit.annotation_method: manual inspection of the rear yellow table-band intersections at the left and right table corners

real_check.annotation_method: manual repeat annotation using the same definitions as real_fit

sim_seed7.annotation_method: manual inspection of the rendered rear yellow table-band intersections

camera_jitter_diagnostic.status: engineering diagnostic bound, not a propagated calibration covariance

candidate_causes_to_test: table extents or robot-base-to-table origin in the twin
resize or crop applied between the native table stream and the downloaded 640x360 archive
stale or wrong physical camera extrinsics/intrinsics
physical camera mount movement after calibration
limitations: The landmarks are manually annotated from compressed 640x360 images and carry explicit pixel uncertainty.
Two table-edge corners cannot identify which candidate cause is correct.
Do not shift the simulated camera, alter the physical calibration, or resize the table solely to make these two landmarks agree.
The active 10 mm versus 16 mm cube-size question is independent of this table-edge audit.
